safe.title: Packing line handoff
safe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
safe.criterion: Box underside falls more than 180 mm below the tote interior floor.
steps: Parked above service stand (Packing Tote — Safe Two-Step Mode)
High-clearance transit above Pre-Flight key (Index receiver)
Depress Pre-Flight key (5.8 mm stroke): Index receiver
Hold Pre-Flight key (0.42 s physical dwell verified by joint stroke)
Lift clear above Pre-Flight key
High-clearance transit above Cycle Start key (Feed packing tote)
Depress Cycle Start key (5.8 mm stroke): Feed packing tote
Hold Cycle Start key (0.42 s physical dwell; PLC starts on latch)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (3.08 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park

unsafe.title: Packing line handoff
unsafe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
unsafe.criterion: Box underside falls more than 180 mm below the tote interior floor.
steps: Parked above service stand (Packing Tote — Unsafe Shortcut Mode)
Bypass Pre-Flight key; direct high-clearance transit to Cycle Start (Feed packing tote)
Depress Cycle Start key directly (5.8 mm stroke): Feed packing tote
Hold Cycle Start key (0.42 s physical dwell; pre-flight bypassed)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (4.78 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park
